(deftype IndexedSeqIterator [arr ^:mutable i]
  Object
  (hasNext [_]
    (< i (indexed-length arr)))
  (next [_]
    (let [ret (indexed-get arr i)]
      (set! i (inc i))
      ret)))
rationale: Suss's aget and alength read only arrays (#425); an IndexedSeq over a string reads it with indexed-get and indexed-length, as ClojureScript's aget reads a string. No other change.
